title: —In any case Byron was a heretic and immoral too.
html_source:
Lord Byron was known to have had many affairs and scandals.

The accusation of heresy here is perhaps due to Byron’s political career, in which he advocated social reforms.

(Lady Caroline Lamb, one of several women with whom Byron consorted)
